segments.name: Machine Clothing
segments.description: Produces custom-designed fabrics and high-speed process belts used by paper and industrial manufacturers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Machine Clothing ("MC") segment is the world's leading producer of custom-designed fabrics and high-speed process belts critical in the manufacture of all grades of paper products characterized primarily as Paper Machine Clothing ("PMC").

segments.name: Albany Engineered Composites
products: 3D-woven composite fan cases for the GE9X engine
3D-woven composite vanes for the F-35 Liftfan
missile bodies for Lockheed Martin's JASSM air-to-surface missiles
fuselage components for the Boeing 787 aircraft
vacuum waste tanks for Boeing commercial aircraft
segments.description: Manufactures highly engineered advanced composite components for aerospace, defense, space and advanced air mobility customers.
segments.evidence: The Albany Engineered Composites ("AEC") segment is a leader in innovative composite technology solutions and manufacturer of engineered components for demanding aerospace and defense applications.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling custom-designed consumable fabrics and belts directly to paper and industrial end-users, and by supplying engineered composite components under long-term contracts to aerospace and defense customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The MC segment sells its products directly to customer end-users in countries across the globe.
